component.name: OpenGMice
component.summary: Configure Logitech G mice on Linux

description.p: OpenGMice sets up Logitech G gaming mice on Linux. It talks to the mouse directly over the HID++ 2.0 protocol and stores the settings in the mouse's on-board memory, so they keep working without the app running.

ul.li: DPI levels with default and DPI-shift level, separate X/Y, live preview
Button assignments: mouse buttons, key combinations, media keys, DPI and profile actions
Logo lighting effects on mice that have it
On-board profiles, battery and device information
Several mice at once, over USB, Bluetooth or a LIGHTSPEED/Unifying receiver

description.p: This is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Logitech. Access to the mouse needs a udev rule on the host: run "flatpak run io.github.sabam54.OpenGMice udev-rule".
Renamed to OpenGMice. DPI fields and slider labels display correctly inside the Flatpak.
First release: tested on the G305 X SUPERLIGHT (Bluetooth) and the G305 (LIGHTSPEED).
